info.title: Jobflow — Distributed Job Scheduler API
info.description: Multi-tenant job scheduling platform. Versioned contract lives under /api/v1; identical unversioned aliases exist for legacy clients and are frozen. Conventions: JSON error envelope {error:{code,message},request_id}; offset pagination envelopes carry total/total_pages; Idempotency-Key header beats body idempotency_key on job creation; PATCH mutates stored state (POST verb-subresources are actions only, deprecated where they duplicate PATCH). Access tokens expire hourly — rotate via /auth/refresh.
